🎯 A 140% intraday wick on $58M volume looks like a monster breakout—until the candle closes in the red.

That is precisely what played out on $IOST, surging to $0.00244 before dumping straight back to $0.00103.

In low-unit-price tokens, violent green candles are rarely organic accumulation.

They are liquidity-generation events.

When retail traders chase rapid momentum spikes, they build the exact buy-side depth that large position holders need to exit heavy inventory without slipping the market.

The invalidation level for this distribution setup.

Spot buyers re-absorbing sell volume and reclaiming $0.00185 with positive order flow delta.

Until then, acceptance below $0.
